data.name: Bird Game: What The Flock
data.detailed_description:
A chaotic PVP party game where you and your friends play as unhinged birds battling over a single precious egg. Use open voice chat to bluff, squawk, scream, and strategize as you dive-bomb enemies, steal their egg, and rush it back to your nest. Fast, frantic, and hilariously loud. This is bird warfare at its finest. Based off the viral meme Bird Game.

🪺 Capture the Egg

The heart of every match is a single, precious egg. Sneak, swoop, or straight-up bully your way into the enemy nest, grab the egg, and haul it home. But holding the egg slows you down—and paints a giant target on your feathery backside. Expect desperate chases, mid-air tackles, and last-second steals that turn the whole match upside down.

🎙️ Proximity Voice Chat

Hear your enemies getting closer… literally. With open proximity chat, nearby players can shout at you, bluff strategies, fake callouts, or panic-scream as they close in. Trash talk becomes a weapon. Strategy becomes chaos. Every match sounds like a wildlife documentary gone horribly wrong.

🪹 Battle Nest: Season 1

Climb the free seasonal Battle Nest to unlock new birds and more.

👥 Team-Based Mayhem

Work together with your flock to set ambushes, defend the nest, run decoy plays, or sacrifice yourself for the egg carrier. Even better—use voice chat to plan, deceive, or intentionally confuse your enemies. Team synergy is powerful… but betrayals are hilarious.

💥 Fast, Frenzied Gameplay

Matches are short, explosive, and always chaotic. Dive-bomb enemies, flap into walls, tackle birds mid-flight, drop the egg on purpose to fake out pursuers, or scream as you’re yeeted into the sky. Every round is unpredictable, loud, and endlessly replayable.

🐦 Choose Your Bird

Pick from an expanding roster of iconic (and slightly feral) birds—each with their own look, personality, and movement quirks.

  • Seagull: Loud, aggressive, loves stealing anything not nailed down.

  • Pigeon: Fast, slippery, perfect for quick snatches and escapes.

  • Parrot: Mimics callouts and causes maximum confusion.

  • …and more unique birds added each season.
